idem.toggle: Idempotency cache enabled (tracks call IDs that already executed)
idem.lost: Response lost in transit before the ops bot received confirmation.
idem.cached: Retry: {id} already recorded as executed. Cached result returned, stock unchanged at {stock}.
idem.verdictOk: Idempotency cache worked: one logical call produced exactly one decrement, even though the network made it look like two separate requests.
idem.verdictBad: No cache, no protection: the same logical call decremented stock twice. In production this is a real inventory bug, phantom shortage caused entirely by a retried request, not an actual second order.
